assertions.name: eps2_ratio_carries_the_A3_convention_band
assertions.source: three readings of 'the' A=3 binding (3He alone / isospin average / 3H alone), width normalised by the central reading; reproduces eps_ratio_target_precision's 9.4292% exactly. Normalising by the low end instead gives 9.8957% for the SAME band -- a normalisation difference, not a discrepancy

assertions.name: eps3_ratio_is_exactly_convention_free
assertions.source: (B(4)/6)/B(2) contains no A=3 quantity, so the mirror convention cannot enter -- structural, not numerical

assertions.name: eps2_supplies_about_one_digit
assertions.source: -log10(band width); with ~1 digit no closed form can be evidence -- the candidate space is unbounded

description: qou-edt7 states its remaining open item as a PAIR -- eps(2)/eps(1) = 1.2137 and eps(3)/eps(1) = 2.1200 -- but eps(2)/eps(1) contains B(3) and eps(3)/eps(1) does not. Pushing the three A=3 mirror conventions through both gives a 9.4% band on the first and identically 0 on the second, so they differ by ~6-7 orders of magnitude in the evidence a closed-form match could carry. Aim derivations at eps(3)/eps(1). Scope-(a): derives nothing, refutes nothing.

digits_available.note: eps3 figure uses the 0.8 eV AME uncertainty on B(4He) stated in ame_2020_binding_energies.py; B(2H)'s own uncertainty is not counted, so it is a LOWER bound on the digits available
